title: Credit Relationship Note — Operating Lines of Credit Reserve on Class H Preferred Stock Purchases, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The operating reserve on a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock purchase rests on how far the member's active operating line (Operating Lines of Credit) is drawn: a line drawn to 0.75 of its commitment or more holds back 10 percent of its outstanding principal; a line drawn to 0.5 or more but below 0.75 holds back 5 percent; a line drawn less, or no active line, holds back nothing.

## Note

| Active operating line: outstanding principal as a share of the commitment | Operating reserve |
|---|---|
| 0.75 or more | 10 percent of the outstanding principal |
| 0.5 or more but below 0.75 | 5 percent of the outstanding principal |
| Below 0.5, or no active operating line | None |

The reserve is read from the member's Operating Lines of Credit records — the line's status, its commitment and its outstanding principal — and is taken off the holding room when the member buys, so that an operating paydown fits under the largest balance a member may hold.

## Worked lines (hypothetical line, commitment 400,000.00)

| Outstanding principal | Share drawn | Reserve |
|---|---|---|
| 320,000.00 | 0.8 | 32,000.00 |
| 300,000.00 | 0.75 exactly | 30,000.00 |
| 220,000.00 | 0.55 | 11,000.00 |
| 200,000.00 | 0.5 exactly | 10,000.00 |
| 150,000.00 | 0.375 | None |
